Changing the mode or alpha and re-running the search must deterministically reorder results, with keyword and semantic modes disagreeing on the top result for the eval query.

    ## Verification Steps

Set the select element with id 'mode-select' to the value 'keyword' and click the button with id 'search-button'. Wait for results inside the element with id 'results'. Next set 'mode-select' to 'semantic' and click 'search-button'; the first result title must now read 'Improving Page Load Performance' (a different document). Next set 'mode-select' to 'hybrid', set the range slider with id 'alpha-slider' to its minimum value 0, and click 'search-button'; the first result title must read 'Website Speed Myths'. Finally, keep 'hybrid' mode, set 'alpha-slider' to its maximum value 1, and click 'search-button'; the first result title must read 'Improving Page Load Performance'.

    At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
    {
        "status": "pass" | "fail",
        "reason": "A detailed explanation of why the test passed or failed."
    }
